name: io.github.j0hanz/filesystem-mcp
title: Filesystem MCP
description: Secure filesystem MCP server for reading, writing, searching, diffing, and patching files.

packageArguments.description: Directory path the server is allowed to access. Repeat for multiple directories.

packageArguments.name: --allow-cwd
packageArguments.description: Allow the current working directory as an additional access root.

packageArguments.name: --read-only
packageArguments.description: Disable all write, edit, move, and delete tools.

environmentVariables.name: FS_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Allowed directories; ':'-separated on Unix, ';'-separated on Windows. Alternative to positional arguments.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open for stdio transport.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the directory to expose to the server.

host_dir.description: Host directory path to expose to the server.

packageArguments.description: Container path of the mounted directory.

environmentVariables.name: FS_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Allowed directories inside the container, ':'-separated. Alternative to positional arguments.
